_comment: The series of the explainer domain, its twin of history/series.json. A dossier's `series` is one of these ids. An explainer is usually one book on its own; the series groups them when there are several.

series.title: Explainers
series.membership: One idea in science or technology, taught from zero to the depth a practitioner works at, with every fact sourced, measured or computed by a script the project can run again.
scoutHints: The original paper or the vendor's own documentation first; an encyclopedia only to find them.
A measurement the project made itself is a source (kind measurement, licence own): say what, on what device, and when.
A number worked out by arithmetic comes from a script in the project's figures/ folder whose printout is a source.
sensitivity: voice.md §7: what a vendor has not documented is stated as observed, never as fact.
No real person's words or feelings invented; a paper's authors are named as its authors.
